case_rebaselines.reason: ALL-FILE0005 moved prefixed test modules into folders; the cases are the same tests under their new paths.
test_consumers checks every consumer import in one case, so its node id no longer depends on whether the tree sits in the monorepo.
The integration tests were grouped into folders by the subsystem each exercises; the cases are the same tests under their new paths.

Test rework (milestone M1): ALL-TEST0004 moved test folders to the package they cover, and the apple, lake, evidence and environments tests were merged into parametrized tests and Hypothesis properties. Each old id below is replaced by the id that took its place; the per-area ledgers (TESTS-<area>.md) hold the full old-to-new map and the before/after coverage showed no line or branch lost.

ALL-TEST0003: test_clouds.py held 23 members against a limit of 20. Each test is the same under the folder of the source it tests, with its doubles in that folder's fakes, builders and conftest; the Vast and RunPod cases also gained assertions (data-center scope, the shared download floor, Secure Cloud only).

Spine merge into live. ALL-FILE0003: integration/dispatch/backends/cloud held 9 test modules against a limit of 5, so the tests follow the sources into curated/ and listed/; each test is unchanged. The four parametrized receipt cases of test_log_finalization.py became four named tests with the same assertions, and the terminal logging test is now a table of two rows (colored, NO_COLOR), so its one id is two.

tests-apple (ALL-FILE0003): integration/apple held 12 modules against a ceiling of 5, so its eight test modules moved into bundle/, xcode/ and toolchain/; the cases are the same tests under their new paths.

tests-pathways (ALL-FILE0003, ALL-FILE0004, PY-CEIL0001): test modules left the full analysis and cli folders and the folders that only led to one child (general, compile, providers) for the folder of the source they cover; the cases are the same tests under their new paths, except that the one 18 statement test of cli/test_apps.py is now the 12 ids of verbs/apps/test_apps.py.

tests-held (ALL-CEIL0001, PY-CEIL0001, ALL-FILE0003): dispatch/test_held.py held 35 members and became held/test_serve.py, held/test_scheduler.py and held/test_line.py, and test_sync_manifest_name.py moved to mirroring/; the cases are the same tests under their new paths, except that the line test is now one table of six rows, so its one id is six.

tests-managed (ALL-FILE0003): integration/engines/environments/managed_python held 6 modules against a ceiling of 5, so test_launcher.py moved into launcher/; the cases are the same tests under their new path.

tests-small (ALL-CEIL0001, PY-CEIL0001): the five native helper tests moved from swift/test_analysis.py to swift/test_native_helper.py under the same names, and the loader test of machines/test_libraries.py is now one table of six rows, so its one id is six.

tests-ceil-1 (PY-CEIL0001): two oversized tests were split and keep every original assertion. The explain test keeps its name for the text check and gained the catalog and JSON checks as two ids, and the sealed bytes test of test_lint_scope.py gained the open draft check as a second id.

tests-ceil-2 (PY-CEIL0001, ALL-CEIL0001): the two Results tests of cli/test_commands.py moved to results/test_results.py with the pyarrow test split into three, the pueue tests of test_scheduler_lifecycle.py moved to dispatch/schedulers/test_pueue.py with the two unplaced states renamed to a test of their own, and the seeded extensions test of gates/test_harness.py is now three tests.
tests-ceil-4 (PY-CEIL0001): the captured trials test of trials/test_trial_source.py is now five tests, each keeping its original assertions, over the same two listing locations (local and snapshot).

cli-regroup: the ten roots (run dep job host proc code git data memory serve) moved every verb of 0.5.7 under its group, so the parametrized CLI ids follow the new paths; two tests were renamed for what they now check. Old ids are what the spine copy the regroup started from (12:30 JST) collects in the three CLI modules whose ids changed; the other touched test modules keep their ids.

cli-app-inspect: bundle, diagnostics and results merged into `code app inspect`. Three verb tests were renamed for what they now check (the id is the function name), and the results test gained a build-status parameter. The three hidden verbs' help and parameter cases of cli-regroup's test_every_command.py have no successor beyond `code app inspect`, which already had its own. New: three inspector tests in integration/apple/test_bundle.py (test_a_path_is_of_one_kind_and_only_that_kinds_inspector_asks_its_tools, test_a_path_of_no_kind_is_refused_naming_the_kinds, test_every_kind_has_exactly_one_inspector_of_its_own; folded there from integration/verbs/apps/, which never reached HEAD, by the review's B1 fix),test_a_build_that_never_reached_its_tests_is_judged_by_its_build_alone (2 params), test_bundle_checks_are_refused_on_a_result_bundle_before_anything_is_read (1).

Regroup rules-engine waves 4a to 7 (ALL-FILE0003, ALL-FILE0004, ALL-CEIL0001, PY-CEIL0001 and the engine's own test folders): test modules moved into the folder of the source they cover or were split; each moved id is listed once in moves.tsv of the regroup program and keeps its assertions.
